explication: MoneyPrinterTurbo turns a topic or keywords into a short video: an API or WebUI accepts the request, generates script and search terms, gathers media, creates voice and subtitles, adds music, renders the video, and exposes task state and artifacts. The sampled code confirms routing, LLM provider resolution, task dispatch/queueing, Redis persistence, cache management, and optional Seedance integration. Several media-stage call edges are inferred from the documented product workflow and service boundaries; unsampled implementations may differ.
